exposure: Free-position delivery combined with perineal massage
outcome: durations of labor (active first stage, second stage)
cohort: The study included 223 high-risk pregnant women who underwent vaginal delivery.
finding: Free-position delivery combined with perineal massage in high-risk pregnant women significantly improved nursing-sensitive quality indicators, reduced perineal trauma and postpartum complications, enhanced neonatal outcomes, and increased maternal satisfaction compared to traditional supine delivery.
mod_finding: Free-position delivery combined with perineal massage led to shorter labor stages, lower rates of perineal lacerations, episiotomy, and postpartum hemorrhage, and improved 5-min Apgar scores compared to traditional supine delivery.
